description: Search the Code of Colorado Regulations (Colorado state administrative rules) by keyword and get back the matching rule DOCUMENTS with CCR number, title, department, agency and effective date -- e.g. "transfer of ownership", "dispensary", "child care licensing". Optionally narrow by department or agency name (e.g. "Department of Revenue"). Pass a returned ccr_number to co_regulation to read it. Colorado Secretary of State, live, keyless.

department.description: Optional department or agency name (or part of it), e.g. "Revenue", "Marijuana Enforcement Division".

query.description: Keywords to find in the regulations, e.g. "transfer of ownership".

name: co_regulation_search
title: Co Regulation Search
